The '''ginntho''', also known as '''Utapau spider''',<ref>[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption Expansion: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption Expansion'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref> was a large species of [[Spider/Legends|spider]] native to [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]].

== Biology ==
Ginnthos lived in the deep caves of Utapau and were equipped with six spinnerets, capable of producing durable silk. Domesticated ginnthos were commonly trained by the native [[Pau'an/Legends|Pau'ans]] to spin silk on command.<ref name=":0">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>

== History ==
[[File:Ginntho.png|thumb|left|200px|A ginntho in the caves of Utapau]]

Shortly before the [[Battle of Utapau/Legends|Battle of Utapau]]<ref name=":1">{{Film|III}}</ref> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]<ref>[[The New Essential Chronology|''The New Essential Chronology'']]</ref> several ginnthos were seen roaming the staples of [[Pau City/Legends|Pau City]],<ref name=":1" /> the capital of [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]].<ref>[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide|''The Clone Wars Campaign Guide'']]</ref> Ginnthos were used to create elaborate traps from their silk to ensnare invading [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]<ref name=":0" /> during the Separatist occupation of [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]] near the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref>''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' {{C|G - "Ginntho"}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
A miniature version is seen on [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]].
